t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes appear in the same colour combinations. If one has a low amount, switch to the other. Switching when it says "x1" is better so there's less risk.

vb_textbox.text: Gnomes always appear in the same colour combinations. Each gnome gives out between 0 and 9 mushrooms. Select the one that consistently gives the most mushrooms. When it's x1, switch to test thme.
